front: Spend 10 minutes treating an injured living creature to restore Hit Points and remove the wounded condition.
back:
10 minutes; target is then immune to Treat Wounds for 1 hour. DC 15 Medicine (expert DC 20, +10 HP; master DC 30, +30; legendary DC 40, +50). Succeeding, you can keep treating a total of 1 hour to double HP.
Crit Success: 4d8 HP and loses wounded.
Success: 2d8 HP and loses wounded.
Crit Failure: target takes 1d8 damage.
